decisions.rationale: Affirmative lexical-absence finding: the source predicate med denies the existence of the virtues and non-virtues in the view. The complete English says only a view about them and contains no negative existential exponent. Neither non-virtue nor non-virtues can be reused for med: both concern distinct terms. Preserve one null for this absent predicate, without inventing English or asserting a corrected publication.
The view noun is directly curated/HGM view. Med is separately recorded as unrendered, so this does not hide a denial inside a broad view-about phrase.
Ablative source of arising is from, distinct from the first causal for and later based on relation.
The first occurrence predicate is present-tense arises in this source reason clause, exact HGM. Bound genitive stays outside.
First causal marker introduces the reason for names/forms being objects. It owns first for, not the later reason about lying.
Second division names the fourth and final class; distinct from the initial third class.

The fourth ordinal is contextually rendered last because the list has exactly four classes. Its auto-mined third and fourth is not curated evidence; this is a local ordinal recast, not a claim that fourth always means last.
Second local objects belongs to the final class and owns the second occurrence.
Third top-level names denotes the final class, distinct from the following names used by speech acts.
Second overt copula belongs to the final-class definition, not the relative that are all part earlier.
Whole speech-falsehood term has exact HGM lying. A rdzun/lying child would duplicate the entire English parent and is therefore omitted.
The entire enumerative expression is a grammatical d6 equivalent with exact HGM and so forth. It excludes supplied all and introduces the remaining speech deeds.
Final names names what those speech deeds depend upon; of things is explanatory English, not an additional Tibetan nominal.
Object of dependence is on, attached to final names. It is not the earlier view about or inclusion of.
Exact HGM based, the lexical dependence verb. Nas is a converb relation distributed into English participial syntax; do not manufacture an ultimately atom.
The final occurrence verb is occur, exact HGM, distinct from the first arises.
Second causal marker owns the for introducing the speech-deed explanation, distinct from first for.
